llm_status_ready: LLM judge: ready (waiting for a turn end)
hint_pace_interval: Progress check + nudge cooldown. 0 = off both.
token_mismatch: Local authentication failed. Check the native messaging host; older runtimes can still use the optional legacy token.
unsupported_tab: This tab is not a supported chat page
open_supported_chat: Open a chat on z.ai / DeepSeek / Claude / ChatGPT, then bind the workspace from the in-page Herdr HUD.
bind_need_chat: Open a supported chat page first, then bind.
already_bound: This conversation is already bound. Unbind first.
hint_url: The extension reaches this local runtime through Chrome Native Messaging and a mode-0600 Unix socket. No Herdr token is stored in the browser.
hint_locale: en / Simplified Chinese / Japanese (same as herdr). First install follows system language; default is English.
hint_tick: Default 60. Progress check while working + post-turn nudge cooldown. 0 = off both.
hint_fallback: If the summary did not change, still send a heartbeat after N seconds from last send. Default 1200 (20 min). 0 = new summary only.
hint_progress_template: Separate from settled template. Same placeholders; {agent}/{pane} are the focus pane.
hint_idle_nudge: ChatGPT only (bound). After a reply settles, ask the configured small model whether to continue. Requires Base URL + Key + Model below.
hint_llm_section: OpenAI-compatible chat/completions. Leave URL/key/model empty to disable post-turn nudge. Secrets stay on this machine.
hint_llm_prompt: Placeholders: {content} {user} {assistant}. Done tokens must match the no-send list. When not done, the model reply is submitted into the chat as-is.
hint_llm_skip: One per line (or comma-separated). If the judge reply is only one of these, do not nudge.
llm_need_config: Fill judge URL, API key, and model first
llm_timeout: Judge request timed out (60s). Check Base URL / network or proxy, then retry.
hint_automation_mode: This is a global capability gate, not the current Project Auto switch. When allowed, each ChatGPT Project can turn Auto on/off from its HUD and share that setting by Project id. Plain ChatGPT /c/<id>, z.ai, and DeepSeek keep their own conversation-scoped HUD Auto regardless of this gate. Every scope defaults off until explicitly enabled in the HUD. ChatGPT in-page permission-card handling is also governed by this Project capability gate.
http_401: HTTP 401 — local authentication failed. Verify the native messaging host; use the optional legacy token only for older runtimes.
loopback_permission_help: Chrome blocked localhost. Open Manage extension → Site settings → Apps on device, then choose Allow.
loopback_timeout_help: Localhost timed out. First allow Apps on device for this extension, then check 127.0.0.1:8772.
native_host_help: The Herdr Native Messaging host is unavailable. Run herdr-mcp native-host install, then reload this extension.
native_ipc_timeout_help: The local Herdr IPC request timed out. Check that herdr-mcp is running and reload the extension.
handoff_project_only: Available for bound ChatGPT Project conversations and persisted z.ai /c/<chat_id> conversations
hud_manual_status_hint: Read Herdr window and agent status, then continue
hud_manual_judge_hint: Use the small model to decide whether to continue
hud_queue_insert_hint: Queue the composer message without interrupting a live reply. Queued messages merge into the next turn after the reply settles. Click with an empty composer to retry; right-click to clear.
hud_queue_need_message: Type a message before adding it to the queue.
hud_queue_added: Queued {count} message(s); they will send after the current reply settles.
hud_queue_sent: Queued message sent as the next turn.
hud_queue_waiting: {count} queued message(s) are waiting for the current reply to settle.
hud_queue_full: The message queue is full. Wait for delivery or clear it before adding more.
hud_queue_extension_reloaded: Herdr was updated. Reload this ChatGPT tab before queueing another message.
hud_queue_background_unavailable: Herdr background is temporarily unavailable. Reload this ChatGPT tab and try again.
hud_queue_storage_unavailable: Queue storage is temporarily unavailable. The message was not queued; try again later.
hud_queue_added_draft_changed: Message queued ({count} total); the composer changed, so the new draft was left untouched.
hud_queue_added_clear_failed: Message queued ({count} total), but the composer could not be cleared safely; it will not auto-send yet.
hud_queue_clear_confirm: Clear {count} queued message(s) for this conversation?
hud_automation_on_hint: Auto is on for the current ChatGPT Project. Other conversations in the same Project and handoff targets share this setting: Herdr progress, settled continuation, post-turn LLM decisions, reply recovery, automatic handoff, and permission-card handling can run automatically. The HUD's Continue / Herdr monitor / LLM analysis buttons are locked. Manual handoff remains available only from Control Center → Current page and preserves Auto on in the target.
hud_automation_off_hint: Auto is off for the current ChatGPT Project. The HUD's Continue / Herdr monitor / LLM analysis buttons are available. Workspace state and bindings remain observed. Manual handoff, when needed, is started only from Control Center → Current page. This setting is shared by all conversations in the same Project.
hud_conversation_automation_on_hint: Auto is on for this conversation only. Supported Herdr progress/settled/recovery behavior can run automatically. The HUD's three preset manual actions are locked. Where z.ai manual handoff is supported, start it only from Control Center → Current page; the target inherits Auto on.
hud_conversation_automation_off_hint: Auto is off for this conversation only. The HUD's Continue / Herdr monitor / LLM analysis buttons are available. A conversation can save this preference before binding; workspace-dependent actions become effective after binding. Where z.ai manual handoff is supported, start it only from Control Center → Current page.
manual_status_continue_intro: Continue from the current Herdr window and Agent state below. Do not repeat completed work; prioritize the current unfinished task.
recovery_probe_template:
Herdr recovery check: the previous assistant turn did not visibly start.
Do not call tools, do not repeat or continue any external action, and do not mutate anything.
Only report whether the previous request appears to have completed in this conversation. If you cannot verify that, reply exactly: recovery needed.
stale_view_activation_template: Herdr browser recovery: this page was refreshed because the previous assistant response appeared stale or stalled. Re-read the latest visible conversation state and continue exactly from where the previous response stopped. Do not repeat completed work. Before any external mutation, re-check current Herdr/runtime/Git state as needed.
default_llm_judge_prompt:
Decide whether the assistant has completed every task requested by the user in the conversation below. If everything is complete, reply only: done. If there is a next step, unfinished work, or pending verification, reply only: continue. Do not explain or add other text. Conversation:
{content}
default_auto_continue_nudge: Continue with the unfinished work you identified.
handoff_request_template:
This is a conversation rollover request from the Herdr browser extension.
Do not continue implementation, do not call tools, and do not ask follow-up questions in this turn.
Summarize the CURRENT working state so a fresh ChatGPT conversation in the same Project can continue without replaying completed work.
Use only facts already established in this conversation. Do not invent current runtime/Git state; the next conversation must verify live state before mutations.
Bound Herdr workspaces: {workspace_line}.
Include: current objective, completed work, important decisions, active/incomplete work, exact files/branches/commits/runtime facts when known, constraints/safety rules, and the recommended next actions.
Keep it compact but operationally complete. Preserve literal identifiers, paths, commands, versions, URLs, and task IDs that matter.
Return exactly one handoff packet between the markers below. No prose before or after the markers.

<<<HERDR_HANDOFF_V1 id={id}>>>
# Project handoff
<!-- write the compact handoff here -->
<<<END_HERDR_HANDOFF_V1>>>

handoff_seed_template:
Continue the same project from the compact handoff below. This message was transferred by the Herdr browser extension.
Treat the handoff as working-state context, not as proof that live state is unchanged.
Before any mutation, verify the relevant current Herdr/runtime/Git state. Do not rerun completed work merely because it is mentioned in the handoff.

[HERDR_CONTINUITY_TRANSFER id={id}]
{packet}
[/HERDR_CONTINUITY_TRANSFER]
cc_phase_body: Workspace and pane state is live. Inspect and output-tail reads run now; Prompt Agent, Steer Session, Herdr API and Terminal Input only build a preview in this release.
cc_target_help: Click a pane above to pin it. Herdr focus changes will not retarget this control.
cc_mode_prompt_help: Build a preview of a new prompt that would be sent to the pinned Herdr agent via agent.prompt. It does not send in this release.
cc_mode_steer_help: Build a preview of an in-flight session steering instruction for a provider/agent that supports steer. It does not send in this release.
cc_mode_herdr_help: Build a preview of an intended Herdr control-plane method call. It is not arbitrary shell execution. Nothing runs now; any future execution must pass the live Herdr method schema and safety checks.
cc_mode_terminal_help: Build a preview of literal text/keys that would be written to the pinned terminal pane. This is the highest-risk path and nothing is written in this release.
cc_placeholder_prompt: Describe the new prompt you would send to the pinned agent.
cc_placeholder_steer: Describe how you would redirect the already-running agent/session.
cc_placeholder_herdr: Enter the validated Herdr method name you would call.
cc_placeholder_terminal: Enter the literal terminal text you would write.
cc_target_stale_short: Target stale · select the pane again
cc_pin_hint: Click to pin this pane as the explicit control target
cc_target_stale: STALE · {reason} · select this pane again before any action
cc_stale_replaced: pane now belongs to a different agent session
cc_page_context_help: Switching browser tabs updates this context automatically. Bind or unbind directly on the workspace rows below; the pinned control target never changes implicitly.
cc_page_unsupported: No supported Herdr conversation in this tab
cc_page_unsupported_meta: Open ChatGPT, Claude, z.ai, or DeepSeek to enable the workspace binding controls below.
cc_workspace_binding_disabled: Open a supported conversation to manage page binding.
cc_page_handoff_started: Handoff started. The active tab may navigate while continuity is verified.
hud_scope_binding_hint: {count} workspace binding(s) for this page. Open Control Center for pane and Agent details.
cc_page_handoff_busy_help: Manual handoff waits for the bound Herdr workspace to become idle. Let the current local work settle, then hand off from this Current page card.
cc_page_handoff_binding_required: Bind at least one workspace before starting a manual handoff.
cc_page_handoff_project_required: ChatGPT manual handoff is available from a concrete conversation inside a Project. Open a Project conversation first.
cc_page_handoff_conversation_required: Open a concrete conversation before starting manual handoff.
cc_page_handoff_unavailable_help: Manual handoff is not available for this page. Supported sources are ChatGPT Project conversations and z.ai conversations.
